name: Kareah
overview: Kareah, also spelled Careah, is identified in Scripture as the father of Johanan, a key military leader during the turbulent period following the fall of Jerusalem. The passages in Jeremiah highlight Johanan's leadership among the remnant of Israel, particularly his role in rallying the people who had been taken captive by Ishmael and his opposition to Ishmael's violent actions. The narrative underscores the trust and support Johanan received from the people, reflecting the significance of Kareah’s lineage in the preservation and protection of the faithful remnant during a time of crisis.
